protocol.weights: Same frozen capture, extraction, and loaded-but-unused insertion checkpoints in both arms

acceptance: The demonstration passes every existing mission-verifier check, including original pre-latch retention reference and 2.5 mm drift bound.
Robot base position is stationary throughout the demonstration.
Demonstration transfer speed, acceleration, payload drift, and extraction stationary dwell improve over the preserved original capture.
Compare original NPZ outcome counts and an additional audit of per-environment payload retention/release using existing mission limits.
Require no loss of aggregate or per-seed successes; inspect every paired condition that changes from pass to fail before promotion.
Do not change geometry, frozen checkpoints, success tolerances, settling windows, or episode horizon to obtain a passing result.
scope: Development regression comparison, not a hardware qualification or new independent 95% reliability claim. Seed 6070 was used during development; failed experiments remain preserved.
